'''Star Tours Flight 201''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was stationed at Gate 1F, and its status was on time, with an estimated time of arrival at 0910 hours. It was scheduled to depart for Coruscant again at 1020.
